def clean(df):
    df = df.copy()
    # drop exact duplicate rows
    df = df.drop_duplicates()
    # normalize text columns
    for col in ['penguin_id', 'species', 'island', 'sex']:
        df[col] = df[col].astype('string').str.strip()
    # fix species label variant
    df['species'] = df['species'].replace({'Adeile': 'Adelie'})
    # fix sex label variant (missing stays missing = unknown)
    df['sex'] = df['sex'].str.lower().replace({'female': 'female', 'male': 'male'})
    # convert numeric-looking text columns to numbers
    for col in ['flipper_length_mm', 'body_mass_g', 'year']:
        df[col] = pd.to_numeric(df[col], errors='coerce')
    # fix out-of-range body mass: values far above 6500 g are in milligrams
    mask = df['body_mass_g'] > 6500
    df.loc[mask, 'body_mass_g'] = df.loc[mask, 'body_mass_g'] / 1000.0
    return df

def answer(df):
    d = clean(df)
    d = d.dropna(subset=['species', 'body_mass_g'])
    means = d.groupby('species')['body_mass_g'].mean()
    return {str(k): float(v) for k, v in means.items()}
